title: CA cert expiry not re-checked at runtime
description: TrustedIssuerStore is built once at startup; CA cert validity is checked then via issuer_from_pem, but never again. If a loaded CA cert expires while the daemon is running, the store continues trusting it indefinitely because verify_and_extract_cn only checks leaf cert validity, not the cached CA. An expired CA should no longer authenticate new leaf certs, but it will until the daemon restarts.
